name: Motolink
description: Logistics operations platform managing clients, delivery riders, work shifts, payment requests, and operational workflows in one centralized system. Improves visibility, cuts manual work, and gives the business more control over delivery operations.

name: Aeras
description: Air conditioning management app with maintenance plans and control notifications. The Aeras Assist module connects users to nearby technicians or companies for maintenance. Includes a view for service companies and technicians to manage PMOCs across multiple clients.

name: Sistema de votação online CBHG
description: Online voting platform for CBHG (Brazilian Field and Indoor Hockey Confederation). Athletes vote for federation representatives every two years through an agile, secure, and transparent flow.

name: Supply Marine Management
description: Internal platform for a specialized company — employee management, daily work reports, customer and asset management, plus PMOC modules. Served as the inspiration for Aeras.

name: SIGH
description: Athlete and club management system for CBHG. Tracks athlete status and handles transfers between clubs. Hosted on Heroku — essential tool for CBHG operations.

name: Econform
description: 100% digital platform for license management and business compliance. Turns a complicated paralegal workflow into an intuitive operation: full visibility of licenses across CNPJs, lower cost, and reduced risk of fines for establishments.

name: Troco Premiado
description: Premium Bond platform: from R$0.01 you buy a capitalization bond. Half goes to a chosen NGO, the other half funds operations and a sweepstake of up to R$50,000 based on the federal lottery.

name: VDireto
description: Platform giving aldermen and mayors direct contact with voters — exposing campaign proposals and answering voter questions.

name: Civis
description: Mobile app making communication with aldermen and mayors easier.

name: Aluno's App
description: Academic app for parents to monitor their children's school performance — teacher contact, attendance list, and school reports.
